details.eligibility: 10th pass + ITI in relevant trade (Grade 3); Diploma/Degree for Grade 1 Signal posts. Age limit as per CEN notification - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: Single CBT: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. Negative marking 1/3. Then Document Verification and Medical Examination.
details.syllabus: Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Science, General Awareness & Current Affairs.
details.important_dates: 2024 cycle: Grade 1 CBT held 19-20 Dec 2024; Grade 3 CBT held 20-30 Dec 2024. 2025 cycle: Grade 3 CBT held 6 Mar 2026; Grade 1 CBT held 13 Mar 2026. 2026 cycle: Grade 3 CBT held 6-9 Oct 2026.

notes: ROUND 3 — 2026-11-21. Years by HELD date. No Technician exam was held in 2025: the 2024 cycle was held Dec 2024 (Grade 1: 19-20 Dec; Grade 3: 20-30 Dec), the next cycle was held Mar 2026 (Grade 3: 6-10 Mar; Grade 1: 13 Mar) and another Grade 3 round was held 8-9 Oct 2026. The Oliveboard Technician hub was NOT re-added — the same page (without the ?ref= tracker) is already in round 1; likewise the Adda247 Technician page (round 1) now also lists the Mar 2026 papers. No official paper PDFs exist: RRB publishes only answer keys/response sheets per CEN on rrbapply.gov.in and regional portals.
